meta.name: Munchkin Paradox Bellows
meta.description: An outrageously over-engineered set of subterranean bellows authorized by The Paradox Symposium of St. Munchkin. Built from Quill-Hollow stratum by the Rivet Assayer, it exploits a hilarious loophole in physics: by continuously blowing warm air onto your tool, it convinces the universe the tool is 'relaxing', drastically cutting durability wear, but the distracting noise significantly slows your mining speed. A perfect example of rule-bending bureaucracy with a legitimate mechanical payoff.
meta.author: core:ground_zero
